tei:div.tei:p: dib sogs las yan/ s+ya ti/ d+ya ti/ byings kyi ā yig ces pa ā ring po ni/ rkyen gyi us dbyi bar bya'o/ /de yang bsgyur ba'i us yin gyi pa ro3k+ṣā'i mang tshig min te/ de la 'phyid pa byings thams cad pa min pa 'dis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /yā thob/ rā len/ h+yasta nī'i an/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigasitsa a bh+yāsta/ bid ad rnams las zhes pas an gyi us 'dis ā dbyi/ a yuḥ a ruḥ byings kyi a yig ni/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge pha rol la'ang dbyi bar bya'o/ /pā btung*/ rā (dā)sbyin/ aṭa/ gnyis brjod/ a yig las aṭa'i au/ pa pau/ da dau/ asti zhes pa/ a sa yod pa'i byings kyi mtha'i sa ni si zhes pa/ sa yig dang po can gyi rkyen pha rol la dbyi bar bya'o/ /as yod/ āt+ma ne'i si/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jig/'dis sa dbyi/ asti'i dang po'i 'o zhes pas a yig dbyi/ bya ti sngon du gzhag pas/ bya ti se/ yang byings de la pa rasmai si/ an 'jigadang po mi 'phyid pas/ a si/ a dang mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge dag pha rol la tshul rol gyi a'i yi ge de dag ru (tu)bsgyur bar bya ste bsgyur ba de nyid dbyi ba yang bya'o/ /ḍupa tsaṣa 'tshed/ ya dza lha mchod/ brta mā na'i an+ti dang e/ an bi/ an bi'i a yig a dang er bsgyur nas dbyi bas/ pa tsan+ti/ ya dzin+ta/ pa tse/ ya dze/ dī nghīng 'bar ba dang tse(rtse)be bī rngan pa mtshungs pa la'o zhes pa 'di dag gi mtha'i dbyangs ni a yig ring thung dang ya yig dag la dbyi bar bya'o/ /shwastā nī'i tā/ iṭa dang bcas pa dang*/ sap+ta mī'i ita dang*/ te/ yaṇa dang bcas pa rnams sbyin pas/ dī nghi ta/ be bītā/ di nghīta/ be bā+-ita/ de ngh+ya te/ be bya te/ nā mi dang gsal byed mtha' can gyi rtags las pha rol tu byed pa po la ā yi byin pa'i yi ge dang po ā dbyi ba bya'o/ /ag+ni/ pa ṭu/ bi bhan+sa/ pa yas byed pa po la ā yi te/ an bi/ nā mi mtha' rnams kyi yin/

ā yig sogs kyis ring po/ ag+nī ya te/ pa ṭu ya te| a nu ṣaṃ ga 'ang kruñca dang sogs kyis/ bi ngh+wan gyi na phyis pas/ bi ngh+wa s+ya te/ pa ya s+ya te/ gnyis pa ni/ gam zhes pa gaml̥ 'gro/ ha na 'tshe/ dza na skye/ kha na dang ghas zhes pa kha nu nges par 'joms pa dang*/ a da za ba la'o/ /zhes pa 'di rnams kyi u pa nghā'i yi ge ni rkyen dbyangs dang po can yin pa a d+ya ta nī'i cha shas kyi an min pa la yon tan med pa pha rol la dbyi bar bya'o/ /de rnams la pa ro3k+ṣā'i a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod sogs/ han la/ a bh+yā sa mapa kyang ngo zhes pas/ ha'i gha/ dzan la/ ta sde'i tsa ṭa'i sogs/ ad la/ pa ro3k+ṣā la yang na 'os ghasli(ghasl̥ )l̥ rjes 'brel/ sgra med pa rnams la zhes sogs kyi gha yig sa yig la ka ka las sa'i ṣa/ dzag+ma tuḥ dzag+muḥ dzagh+na tuḥ dzagh+naḥ dza dz+nya tuḥ dza dz+nyuḥ tsa kha na tuḥ tsakh+nuḥ dzak+ṣa tuḥ dzak+ṣuḥ kā ri ta'i in ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i cha shas kyi ām dang*/ shwasta nī'i tā sogs la brten pa'i iṭa ā ga ma dang*/ an bi ka ra ṇa sogs kyi bi ka ra ṇa min pa'i rkyen gzhan rnams pha rol la dbyi bar bya'/ོ/ kṝ hṛ i in las nā mi'i 'phel ba/ kā ri ta'i mtha' rnams las yu'o zhes pas/ kṛta kyi yu'i rkyen yu'i ana'o/ /zhes pas ana'o rkyen bud med la ā/ mtshungs 'dra/ si/ shrang+nghā las si dbyi/ kā ra ṇā hā ra ṇā/ yang*/ kā ri/ hā ri la/ di+e| aṭa/ tsaṇa/ iṇa dang*/ tsaṇa la mtshungs pa ma phyis pa'i u pa nghā thung ngu*/ gnyis brjod/ mtshungs pa ma phyis pa sogs kyis i nyid dang yang ba'i ring po sogs byas pas/ a tsī ka rata/ a dzī ha rata/ bu rgyud kyi don la byas pa'i dbyangs snga ma can/ min pa'i ya'i yi ge ni yin dang ā yi gnyis pha rol la dbyi zhing ī'i rkyen rnams la'o/ /garga'i bu brgyud la/ garga sogs las ṇ+ya/ ṇa yig rjes 'brel dang 'phel ba/ i'i yi ge dang*/ a yi ge sogs/ ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa la yin/

byed pa po la ā yi ṇ+ya las so/ /zhes pas/ ī'i rkyen/ 'dis ya dbyi/ yin la a yig gi'o zhes pas ā yig ī/ ā yi la mtshungs 'dre| 'di gnyis la ti/ an bi/ ī la/ bud med du byas pa'i ā yig la a dbyi ba rnams byas pas/ gārgam ti/ gārgā ya ti/ gārgī/ phyi ma 'di la/ si/ ī yig mtha' las de dbyi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yin dang ā yi pha rol la t+t+ya kyi na yig dbyi ba'ang ngo*/ /pan+thi/ rā dzan/ bi nghān+sa/ yin/ ā yi/ dang po la/ nā mi mtha' rnams kyi yin ā yi zhes pas ring po dang*/ de yang phyi ma la/ nā mi dang gsal byed mtha' las zhes pas ā yi dang po phyis pas/ pa thī ya ti/ pa thī ya ti+e| rā dzā ya ti/ rā dzā ya ti/ bi d+ya s+ya ti/ bi d+ya s+ya ti rnams so/ /mdo 'di'i bya ba ni/ ming ler gsal byed la'ang 'di rnams kyi na'o/ /rtags mtha'i na yig go'o/ /a nu ṣaṃ ga 'ang kruñca dang ita min pa'i'o/ /zhes pas grub kyang*/ 'dir smos pa ni/ spyir kṛta dang*/ ming le sbyar ba'i sgrub tshul gcig dang*/ kun bshad kyi sgrub tshul gcig te/ gnyis gnyis yod pas mi 'gal zhing*/ slob phan du/ 'di ni t+t+ya kyi na yig gi dbang du byas par bshad do/ /byings gsal byed mtha' las a d+ya ta ni di dang si dag ni dbyi bar bya'o/ /dīṣa mi dga'/ du ha 'jo/ li ha ro myang*/ di/ si/ dang por aṭa da dang po'i ha'i gha/ liha'i ga'i ḍhe| phyis pa la'ang di si dag la 'os da'i ngha/ tshig mthar zhes pas ṣa dang ḍha'i ṭe| gha'i ka a dweṭa/ gnyis/ a nghoka a leṭa/ a leṭa/ di si 'di dag ni/ h+yasta nī'i yin na an bi thob kyang*/ byings 'di dag ad sogs yin pas 'jig pa'i phyir/ gsal byed mtha' can yin pas/ di si'i dbyangs gsal gnyis ka 'jig la/ bhu yod pa la/ di/ si/ an bi/ yon tan/ 'di'i rigs la 'di si'i i 'phyid pas/ a bha bta/ a bha baḥ ḍu patsa la ya sgra sbyar ba'i/ pā pa ts+ya lta bu'i ya yig ni an bi ka ra ṇa med pa'i shwasta nī'i lta bu la dbyi bar bya'o/

/rkyen de la/ iṭa 'byung bas/ pā pa tsa tā/ 'o na ya sgra'i a yig gang gis 'phyid na/ a'i 'ang dbyi'o zhes pa 'dis so/ /'on kyang ya 'phyid rgyu la byings min pa dang 'brel ba dgos la/ a 'phyid rgyu la de bzlog par slob phan gyis bshad la/ snga ma'i dper brjod ya sgra la byas pa ni/ de rnams byings so zhes ya sgra byings su bshad pa dang 'gal bar sems so/ /'on kyang phyi ma la tsi kīr+ṣa zhes rtags las/ shwasta nī'i tā byin pa'i tshe/ iṭa la a yig dbyi bar bya ba yin pas/ tsi kīr+ṣi rā zhes pa 'byung ngo*/ /gong gi dbyi'o zhes pa da rung rgyud mdo snga ma zhugs nas a d+ya ta nī si tsa dbyi bar bya ste/ rkyen nghā yig dang po can pha rol la dang*/ byings mtha' nghuṭa las kyang rkyen nghuṭa dang po can la dang*/ byings mtha' dbyangs thung ngu las kyang pha rol gyi iṭa med pa'i nghuṭa pha rol la dnge*| byings mtha'i iṭa ā ga ma las kyang sitsa rang gis drangs pa'i īṭa ring po pha rol la ste/ de rnams kyi bar du byung ba'i sitsa 'phyid pa'o/ /dper na/ lūnya gcod/ dh+wam/ sitsa/ iṭa/ yon tan/ al/ bi ngh+wam/ zhes pa dang*/ bhi dir 'joms/ ta/ a bhit+ta zhes pa dang*/ ḍukṛnya/ ta/ a kṛ ta/ zhes pa dang*/ lūnya gcod/ di/ sitsa/ iṭa/ īṭa/ dbyangs mtha' rnams sitsa la zhes pas 'phel ba/ a lā bīta/ zhar byung ni byings kyi mthar brtsegs pa'i dang por byung ba'i sa yig dang*/ ka yig dag ni tshig mthar 'jug bzhin pa la'ang dbyi bar bya'o/ /ra bha rtsom/ la bha thob/ tum san/ san la mi mī sogs kyi byings kyi dbyangs is/ ris+bha/ lis+bha/ gnyis brjod a bh+yā sa'ang dbyi/ āng sngon/ sgra med pa sogs a rip+sa te/ tsak+ṣing gsal/ ing brjod don/ te/ an bi/

'jigaṣa dang ṭa sde sogs/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra bar byas pas/ tsaṣ+te/ gsum pa la mi 'dra ba'i yi ge la dang ā yi la dang*/ tshu rol la thung ngu la dang*/ yan la dang*/ an la dang*/ pa rasmai la dang*/ bi ka ra ṇa dang*/ byings thams cad pa la brten pa'i lus 'gyur rnams so/ /dang po ni/ byings mtha'i tsa sde ni pha rol 'dra ba'i yi ge min pa la ki ru bsgyur bar bya ste/ i yig brjod don du byas nas ka yig nyid du byed pa'o/ /de yang slob phan du/ pha rol nghuṭa la dang*/ mtha' la'ang zhes pa 'di nas skyes par zhes pa'i bar du 'jug par bshad do/ /pa tsa/ ya dza/ yu dzir/ shāsta nī'i tā/ pak+tā/ yak+tā/ yok+tā/ bshad ma thag pa'i rkyen de lta bu pha rol la mtha'i ha'i yi ge ni ḍ+dha yig tu bsgyur zhing*/ byings du ha lta bu da dang po can gyi ha ni gha ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /li ha ro myang*/ s+ya ti/ yon tan/ ṣa ḍha dag gi sa la ka lek+ṣ+ya ti/ ba ha thob/ tā/ 'dis ḍha/ gha ḍha ngha bha zhes pas/ tā yig ngha| ta sde'i tsa ṭa'i zhes pas ḍha/ ḍha'i ḍha la dbyi/ sa hi ba hi dag gi a'i/ ota to| bo ḍha/ duha/ s+yata/ 'di dang byings kyi gsum pa/ dang po sogs dang*/ sgra med pa zhes pa dang por aṭa dang yon tan rnams byas pas/ a nghok+ṣ+ya ta/ na hi zhes pa ṇa ha 'ching ba'i byings kyi/ ha ni rkyen snga ma la dha ru 'gyur ba'o/ /ṇaha/ tā| s+ya ti/ gha ḍha ngha bha sogs dang*/ nghuṭa rnams kyi bzhi pa sogs dang*/ sgra med pa sogs byas/ naḍhā/ natas+ya ti/ rkyen de la bhṛdza sogs drug po rnams kyi dza yig ni ṣa yig tu 'gyur ba'o/ /bh+ras+dza 'tshed pa'i lus 'gyur/ bh+ras+dzi dang bh+ras+dzi nyid dang*/ sṛdza gcod/ mṛ dzu ṣa dag ya dza lha mchod/ rā dzṛ 'bar ba rnams ni| bh+ras+dzi sogs te/ bh+ras+dzi/ bh+ras+dza/ sṛdza/ mṛdza/ yadza/ rā dza zhes pa rnams so// rkyen tā/ s+ya ti/ brtsegs pa dang po'i sa ka sogs dang*/ ṣa ḍ+dha dag gi sogs/ bh+raṣ+ta/ bh+rak+ṣ+ya ti sogs so/ /prats+tsha shes par 'dod/

bi sha 'jug sogs kyi tsha sha dag kyang ṣa ru bsgyur bas/ praṣ+ta/ prak+ṣ+ya ti/ beṣ+ta/ bek+ṣ+ya ti/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar skyes par brjod par da lta bud med la 'jug bzhin pa de nyid ā yi'i rkyen pha rol las skyes pa'i gzugs gang yin pa der 'gyur ba'o/ /bṛhū brtson/ u yig ni/ swārti sogs kyi don/ gzhan las kyang mthong ngos ma ning*/ phrad las a yig ā ga ma'o/ /ṛ yig gi ra yig go /rkyen gyi in brjod don/ bh+rah+man/ bu brgyud la/ aṇa/ ṇa dang bcas pa la dang por 'phel/ bud med la ī/ ā yig la a dbyi/ brāh+ma ṇī/ byed pa po la ī yi ste/ an bi/ brāh+ma ṇā ya te/ gsum pa ni/ a yig las pha rol rkyen ā tām dang*/ ā thāṃ zhes pa 'di dag gi dang po'i i nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /patsa/ yadza/ pañca mī'i ā tāṃ/ ā thāṃ/ an bi/ 'dis ā yig i/ mtshams sbyar/ pa tse tāṃ/ pa tse thāṃ| ya dze tāṃ/ ya dze thāṃ/ de bzhin a yig las pha rol gyi brta mā nā'i ā te/ ā the zhes pa'i ā yang i nyid 'gyur bas/ pa tse te/ pa tse the/ de las pha rol gyi ya sgra'i yang i nyid du 'gyur te/ de yang sap+ta mī'i ya sgra yin na'o/ /yāta/ yātāṃ/ yas| patse/ pa tse tāṃ/ pa tseḥ de bzhin du/ de las sap+ta mī'i yām dang yus dag ni i yam dang i yus dag tu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /pa tse yaṃ/ pa tse yuḥ bzhi pa ni/ sham sogs brgyad po rnams kyi dbyangs ni yan bi pha rol la ring po'/ོ/ sha mu dang da mu zhi/ ta mu 'dod/ shra mu dka' thub/ bh+ra mu g.yo/ k+ṣa mu mdzod/ kla mu dman/ ma di dga'/ zhes pa rnams kyi lus 'gyur/ sham/ dam| tam/ shram/ bh+ram/ k+ṣam/ klam/ mdo rnams ni sham sogs te/ de rnams la/ ti/ yan/ shā mya ti nas/ mā d+ya ti sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ ṣ+ṭhi bu sel/ kla mu dman/ āng sngon ma can gyi tsa mu za ba rnams kyi dbyangs ni an bi ka ra ṇa la ring po'/ོ/ ṣ+ṭhi ba ti/ klā ma ti/ ā tsa ma ti/ drug pa ni/ 'di nas dza na'i bi ka ra ḍa la dzā'o zhes pa la thug pa'i bar mdo bcu bzhi la/

pa rasmai pha rol la zhes pa sbyar bar bya ba yin pas/ kra mi zhes pa/ kra mu rkang pa bskyod pa'i byings 'di| de la ring por 'gyur te/ ti/ an bi/ krā ma ti/ rkyen de la gam i ṣū yam zhes pa/ gaml̥ 'gro/ iṣū 'dod/ ya mu nye bar 'jiga'adi rnams kyi mtha'i ma dang ṣa ni tsha nyid du 'gyur zhing*/ dbyangs las pha rol tsha yig gnyis dang*| sgra med pa rnams la zhes pa byas pas/ gats+tsha ti/ its+tsha ti/ yats+tsha ti/ pā btung ba la'o zhes pa 'di'i pi wa ru 'gyur bar bya'o/ /pi ba ti/ gh+rā dri len pa'i byings ni dzi gh+ra ru 'gyur bas/ dzi gh+ra ti/ ng+nghāmā sgra dang me kun tu sbyor ba la'o zhes pa 'di'i ngha ma zhes pa ngha dang ma so sor phral ba'i ma srog med dang bcas par 'gyur bas/ ngha ma ti/ s+thā gnas pa la'o zhes pa 'di'i tiṣ+ṭha ru bsgyur bar bya'o// tiṣ+ṭha ti/ m+nā goms pa la'o zhes pa 'di'i phral ba'i man ru 'gyur ba'o/ /ma na ti/ dā na sbyin pa la'o zhes 'di'i yats+tsha zhes par 'gyur ba'o/ /yats+tsha ti/ dṛ shir lta ba la'o 'di'i pa sh+ya zhes par 'gyur ba'o/ /pa sh+ya ti/ arti zhes pa ṛ rab tu thob par 'byed pa la'o skye ba la'o zhes pa 'di ni ṛts+tsha zhes bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ṛts+tsha ti/ sarti zhes pa sṛ 'gro ba la'o zhes pa 'di'i nghā ba ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /nghā ba ti sha di zhes pa bhu sogs dang rgyud sogs kyi sha 'i shī ya ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /shī ya ti| sa dī zhes pa ṣa 'gro ba'i sā di'o/ /sī da ti/ bdun pa ni/ bi ka ra ṇa pha rol la dza nī rab tu skye ba'i byings dzā ru bsgyur zhing*/ dz+nyā khong du chud pa'i byings kyang dzā'o/ /te/ yaṇa/ dzā ya te gnyis/ yang na phyi ma la nā bi ka ra ṇa/ dzā nā ti/ yaṇa la bi ka ra ṇa'i tha snyad mi 'thob bo zhes zer ba rnams ni/ 'dir bi ka ra ṇa'i dper brjod yaṇa la 'grel pas bshad pa 'di nyid mthong bar zad do| |pūnya dgasogs pa/ mū nya gcod/ s+tṛnya 'gebs/

zhes sogs rnams kyi dbyangs ni bi ka ra ṇa la thung ngu nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /ti/ nā bi/ pū nā ti/ lu nā ti/ s+tṛ nā ti/ brgyad pa ni/ rkyen gsal byed dang po yon tan can gyi byings thams cad pa kyi ('am)gzhi mthun pha rol la byings uta ces pa u yig thung ngu 'phel bar 'gyur te/ nā mi mtha'i byings dang sogasakyi dmigs bsal lo// yu spel/ ṣa bstod/ ti/ si/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigayau ti/ yau ṣi/ stau ti/ stau ṣi/ ū ti zhes pa ūr+ṇanya 'gebs pa'i byings kyi mtha'i u ni rkyen de 'dra la yon tan no/ /byings de la/ pra sngon/ ti/ si/ mi/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jig /pror+ṇo ti/ pror+ṇo ṣi/ pror+ṇo mi/ byings de ni byings thams cad pa la yon tan du 'gyur bar ma zad*/ h+yasta ni pha rol la yang yon tan du 'gyur te/ pra sngon di si dbyangs dang po can gyi dang po'i 'phel ba'o// mtshams sbyar/ praur+ṇata/ praur+ṇaḥ 'dis ni h+yasta nī byings thams cad pa'i nang du ma 'dus pa lta bur bshad 'dug pa ji ltar yin brtags par bya ste/ 'grel pa gnyis kar dang*/ mdo ṭīka kun gyis dogs pa ma bcad do/ /bzhi pa la/ iṭa dang*/ īṭa dang*/ aṭa dang*/ ta tha rnams ā ga ma'o*/ dang po ni*/ tṛ hi 'tshe zhes pa 'di'i gsal byed dang po yon tan can la bi ka ra ṇa la pha rol tu iṭa ā ga ma 'gyur ba'o/ /byings de la/ ti/ si/ mi/ ru ngha sogs kyi dbyangs las na sgra/ 'dis iṭa/ a'i i la e sogs so/ /ha'i ḍha gha ḍha zhes pas ta'i ngha/ ṣa dang ṭa sde zhes pas ngha'i ḍha/ ḍha'i ḍha rnams la dbyi/ bar pa la/ ṣa ḍha dag gi sa la ka sogs/ tṛ ṇi nghi/ tṛ nek+ṣi/ tṛ ṇi h+mi/ gnyis pa ni/ brūnya las pha rol gyi ngag gang yin pa de'i gsal byed dang po yon tan can byings thams cad pa'i dang por īṭa ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /ṭa yig ni/ iṭa las kyang īṭa la'o zhes pa'i don/ ti/ si/ mi/ tu/ di/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jiga'adis īṭa/

yon tan tshig mthar nghuṭa/ bra bī ti/ bra bī ṣi/ bra bī mi/ bra bī tu/ a bra bīta/ asti zhes pa/ as yod pa'i byings las pha rol tu/ di si dag byung ba la īṭa ā ga ma 'gyur/ a sī ta/ a sīḥ sitsa las pha rol gyi di si dag la īṭa ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /kṛnya/ lūnya/ di/ si/ sitsa/ dbyangs mtha' rnams kyi si tsa la pa rasmai la'o zhes pas 'phel ba/ 'dis īṭa byings gnyis pa la/ sitsa'i sngon du iṭa īṭa ring thung gi bar gyi sitsa phyis pas/ a kār+ṣita/ a kār+ṣīḥ a lā bī ta/ a lā bīḥ byings tud sogs rnams las kyang pha rol gyi di si dag la īṭa ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /tud sogs las byings thams cad pa la zhes pas iṭa thob pa la'o/ /ru dir mchi ma 'dzag nyi ṣ+wa pa nyal/ shwa pa srog 'jigadzak+ṣa za ba dang rgod/ di si an bi/ ad sogs las 'jiga'adis i?ṭa/ rungha'i u pa ngha zhes pas yon tan/ a ro dīr/ a ro dīḥ de bzhin du| sra pī ta/ shwa sīta/ dzak+ṣī ta sogs dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ad las zhes pa/ a da za ba'i byings las pha rol gyi di si dag las aṭa ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /ṭa yig ṭīta dang po dang tha ma dag go zhes pa'i don/ di/ si/ a yig gi ā yig/ā dar/ ā dāḥ tsan+d+ra par/ rud sogs lnga rnams las aṭa yang na'o zhes lnga ni sngar gyi bzhi po'i steng du a na bsnan no/ /bzhi pa ni/ a da za ba'i lus 'gyur ghasl̥ dang*/ ba sa kun nas 'gebs pa sogs kyi sa'i yi ge ni san gyi sa pha rol la ta ru 'gyur te/ rkyen byings thams cad pa ma yin pa la'o/ /tum/ san/ ti/ an bi/ gnyis brjod sogs/ dza ghat+pa ti/ bi bat+pa ti| a d+ya ta ni'i cha shas aṇa pha rol la ba tsi zhes pa/ btsa brjod pa'i byings kyi u pa nghā ni o nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /di/ tām/ a bo tsa tāṃ rkyen de la/ a s+ya ti zhes pa/ a su 'phen pa'i byings kyi mtha' ni tha ā ga ma 'gyur ba'o/ /as+thā ta/ rkyen de la/ pa ti zhes pa pa 'gro ba'i byings ni pap+ti zhes par 'gyur pa'i i brjod don du byas pas/

a pap+tata/ kṛ pa zhes pa kṛ pū nus pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings 'di yon tan du byas pa'i r yig ni ma nyid du bsgyur bar bya'/ོ/ 'di ni yon tan gang yod kyi rkyen pha rol la bltos par gsal lo/ des na shwasta nī'i tā la/ ka /s+ya ti la/ ka ti/ 'dir slob phan du/ a ya ti la nyer bsgyur gyi'o/ /zhes pa ni/ a ya ti zhes pa/ a ya 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings 'di pha rol la rang gi sngon du byung ba'i nyer bsgyur gyi ra yig la ru 'gyur bar bya'o/ /byings de'i sngon du ra te an bi pa la ya te/ gi ra ti/ zhes pa/ gṛ gsal ba la'o zhes pa'i byings 'di'i yon tan byas pa'i ra yig ni tse krī yi ta pha rol la la yig tu 'gyur ba'o/ /byings de las ya sgra/ ṝta mtha'i yon tan med pa la ir/ gnyis brjod/ a bh+ya sa la yon tan/ dze gi l+ya ti/ te/ an byas pa'o/ /byings de'i ra yig ni/ an bi sogs kyi dbyangs pha rol la la yig tu yang na bsgyur bar bya'o/ /gi la ti/ gi ra ti*/ an bi/ tud sogs la yon tan med pas/ ir du bsgyur ba'i rjes so/ /byings kyi dang po sde pa'i gsum pa yin pa dang gha dang ḍha dang ngha dang bha rnams mtha' na yod pa'i dang po'i gsal byed rnams ni/ rkyen gyi cha shas sa dang ngh+wa dag pha rol la rang rang gi bzhi pa nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /gu hū sngom/ du ha 'jo/ bungha rtogs/ dan bhu tshul 'chos/ bya ba shor ba'i s+yata/ ha snga ma ha'i ḍha/ phyi ma da dang po'i ha'i gha/ ṣa ḍha dag gi dang*/ sgra med pa rnams la zhes sogs a nghok+ṣ+yata/ a ghok+ṣ+yata/ a bho ta/ dan bhu'i na phyis pas/ a ngha ta/ de rnams pha rol de dpe yin la byings de rnams las/ ngh+wā ma/ a nghu /a ghu / a bhu / byings khyad chos snga ma rnams las pha rol tu/ di si phyis pa dag la'ang byings kyi dang po de bzhi par 'gyur ro/ /tuha/ di/ si/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigayon tan| gsal byed las di si dbyi/ gzhan snga ma bzhin/

tshig mthar nghuṭa sogs byas pas/ a nghoka da nghā ti zhes pa/ ḍunghānya 'dzin zhes pa las/ ta dang tha dag la'ang sngar bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /brta mā na'i tas thas an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs pas 'jig cing*/ de la byings lan gnyis/ thog mar gnyis pa bzhi pa sogs/ a bh+yasta sogs kyi mtha'i a dbyi/ a bh+yā sa'i da yig ni 'dis ngha ru bsgyur/ sgra med pa rnams la sogs/ nghat+taḥ nghat+thaḥ kun bshad pa rkang pa drug pa'i 'grel pa rdzogs so// //bdun pa la dngos dang*/ zhar la suṭa ā ga ma bshad pa'o/ /dang po la*/ iṭa thob pa la sgrub pa dang*/ mi thob pa la dgag pa'o/ dang po la/ byings thams cad min pa la dang*/ de yin pa la dang*/ slar yang min pa la dang*/ si tsa la dang/ san la brten pa'i rkyen pa'i rnams la bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byings thams cad ma yin pa las pha rol tu rkyen ya yig dang po can ma yin pa'i rkyen gyi dang por iṭa ā ga ma 'gyur ba'o/ /ṭa yig īṭa las kyang iṭa la'o zhes sogs khyad par gyi don du rjes 'brel/ a sa yod/ s+ya ti/ s+yata/ tā/ asti'i byings thams cad pa min pa la bhu/ 'dis iṭa/ yon tan/ bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ a bi ṣ+yata/ bha bi tā/ rkyen khyad chos 'di tshang ba yin na/ kṛta kyi rkyen la'ang 'dra bas/ wuṇa tṛ tsa'i tṛtsa/ tsa dbyangs don/ byings de la/ tum dang*/ ta bya/ 'dis iṭa/ mthar si/ dṛ'i ṛ yig si la ā ste si dbyi ba 'ang ngo*/ /bar pa la mi zad pa las si dbyi/ ta byaṃ la si mu/ bha bi tum/ bha bi ta byaṃ/ byings thams cad pa yin na/ te/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jig pas/ aste gsal byed dang po can min pa ni/ aṭa/ ba bhu ba/ ya yig dang po can yin na/ bhū yāta/ snu zhes pa| ṣ+ṇu rab tu 'dzagakra mi zhes pa/ kra mu rkang pa bskyod pa dag las rkyen snga ma'i mtshan nyid can pa rasmai'i tshig la iṭa 'gyur ba'o/ /snā bi tā/ kra mi tā/ gnyis pa ni/ tud sogs zhes pa/ ru dir mchi ma 'dzaganyiṣ+wapa nyal/ shwas srog|a na yang ngo*/

/dzak+ṣa za/ 'di rnams las pha rol tu gsal byed dang po can ya yig dang po min zhing byings thams cad pa yin pa'i rkyen la dang por iṭa'o/ /ti/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigaro di ti/ swa pi ti/ a ni ti| dzak+ṣi ti/ ī sha dbang phyug nyid la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las rkyen khyad chos bshad ma thag pa gang zhig sa yig dang po can pha rol la iṭa'o/ /se/ an bi/ 'jig|ī shi she īṭa bstod/ dza na skyed/ 'di dag gis sa yig ngh+wa sgra dang po can gyi byings thams cad pa la dang por iṭa'o/ /se ngh+wa e ṭi she ī ḍi ngh+wa/ gsum pa ni/ pa rasmai zhes 'dir smos pa'i tshig rgyun las/ byings thams cad pa min pa zhes pa rjes su 'jug par slob phan las bshad pas/ gam zhes pa/ gaml̥ 'gro ba'i byings las pha rol tu byings thams cad pa min pa'i sa la pa rasmai'i tshig la iṭa'o/ /s+yati/ s+yata/ ga mi ṣ+ya ti/ ga ma ṣ+ya ta/ han 'tshe ba dang pṛng*| bṛnya min pa'i ṛta mtha' ḍu kṛnya sogs las s+ya ti sogs kyi s+ya pha rol la dang por iṭa'o/ /ha ni ṣ+ya ti/ bzhi pa ni/ añji zhes pa añju 'gro ba dang mchod pa la'o zhes 'di las pha rol tu byung ba'i sitsa la dang por iṭa'o/ di/ si tsa/ de la/ ti tāṃ/ an/ si tsa/ iṭa/ di la īṭa/ de gnyis kyi bar gyi si tsa dbyi/ si tsa a bh+yāsta āta rnams las zhes pas/ in gyi us/ byings kyi dbyangs a yig gi ā yig go /añjiṣ+taṃ/ añju ṣūḥ si tsa med na/ aṅk+tā/ sū su nghūnya zhes pa/ ṣ+tunya bstod/ ṣunya mngon par skye/ nghūnya g.yo ba rnams las pa rasmai la brten pa'i si tsa la īṭa'o/ /dbyangs mtha' rnams kyi si tsa la sogs kyis 'phel ba/ asta bīta/ a sā bīta/ a dhā bita/ iṭa ring thung gi bar du si tsa phyis pa'o/ /ya mi ra min mi āta mtha' zhes pa ya mu 'jigar mu rtse/ ṇam rab tu 'dud/ yā thob pa lta bu rnams kyi byings mthar pa rasmai'i si tsa la'i mtha' zhes pas yig ā ga ma'o/ /ti tāṃ/ an/ iṭa ring thung sogs sngar bzhin byas pas/

a yaṃ sīta/ a yaṃ sīṣ+taṃḥ a yaṃ si ṣūḥ a taṃ/ a naṃ/ ā ya rnams la sbyar ro/ lnga pa ni/ sming zhes pa/ ṣ+mi cung zad rgod/ pūng gtsang*/ ṛ 'gro/ añju gsal/ a shu khyab/ kṛ rnam par g.yeng*/ gṝ gsal bar byed/ dṝng ma gus/ nghṛng nges par 'jigaprats+tsha shes par 'dod par rnams kyi pha rol tu san la dang po iṭa'o/ /de rnams la/ tum san/ tum 'jig gnyis brjod sogs san gyi bya ba rnams byas pas/ sisma yi ṣa ti/ de bzhin du/ su pa pi| a ri ri/ añji dzi/ a shi shi tsa ka ri/ dzi ga ra/ di da ri/ di ngha ri/ pi prats+tsha rnams la ṣa ti sbyar ro/ /gra hi zhes pa/ gra ha nye bar len zhes pa 'di las pha rol du pa ro3k+ṣā min pa'i rkyen la iṭa'i i ni ring por bsgyur bar bya'o// gra hī tā/ gra hī ṣ+ya ti/ gnyis pa la/ dbyangs las dang*/ gsal byed las dang*/ rkyen snatshogs las iṭa bkag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ā ring pa dang*/ i ring thung dang*| u thung ngu dang*/ ṛ thung ngu las/ iṭa bkag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ḍudānya lta bu/ āta zhes pa/ ā ring po las med la/ de yang byings dbyangs gcig pa las pha rol tu iṭa med do/ /dā tā/ dā s+ya ti/ gnyis pa ni/ tsinya sog pa sogs i yig las pha rol tu iṭa med cing*/ 'on kyang ṭu o shwi dang shrinya brten pa dang*/ ḍīng 'phur/ shīng nyal ba rnams la iṭa yod pas/ de rnams ma yin pa las so/ /tse tā/ tse s+ya ti/ dbyangs gcig pa ni/ 'di la'ang sbyar dgos te/ de ma yin na/ dī nghīng 'bar/ dī di tā thob pa rnams la/ shwā yi tā/ shrā ye tā/ ḍa yi tā/ sha yi tā/ iṭa yon tan byas pa'o/ /'dir ḍīng shīng la dogs pa bcad cing*/ dbyangs gcig pa'ang si ring la sbyar bas na/ rtsa ba'i yig gis i ring thung gnyis ka gzung bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na/ i'i yi ge zhes pa lta bu'i drug sgra med na/ thung ngu 'dzin pa mdo 'di pa'i lugs yin no|

|zhes bla ma snga ma rnams gsung ba la 'dis gnod do/ gsum pa ni/ uta ces pa ṣ+tu bstod pas sogs u yig thung ngu dbyangs gcig pa'i byings las iṭa med la/ 'on kyang yu sprel(spel)/ ru sgra/ ṇu bstod/ snu zhes pa/ ṣ+ṇu 'dzagaṭuk+ṣu sgra/ k+ṣ+ṇu rno zhes pa 'di rnams la/ iṭa yod pas de rnams ma yin pa las so/ /sto tā/ sto ṭh+ya ti/ u yig ring po yin na/ lūnya gcod/ la bī tā| gang dmigs kyis bsal ba rnams ni/ ya bi tā/ ra bi tā/ na bi tā/ sna bi tā| k+ṣa bi tā/ bzhi pa ni/ ṛta ces pa/ ḍukṛnya sogs ṛ yig thung ngu'i mtha' las iṭa med la/ 'on kyang bṛ yang dag par gus/ bṛnya sgrib ces pa 'di gnyis la iṭa yod pas de gnyis ma yin pa las sogs/ kartā/ hartā dbyangs gcig pa min na/ dzā gṛ gnyid bsad/ dzā ga ri tā/ gnyis pa las ka sde dang*/ tsa sde dang*/ ta sde dang*/ pa sde dang*/ dro ba las iṭa dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di nas rkyen byings thams cad pa min pa la zhes sbyar te/ gra ha/ gu ha zhes pa la thug gi bar du'o/ /sha ki zhes pa/ sha ka bzod pa'am shakl̥ nus pa'i byings las pha rol tu ka las iṭa med do/ /shak+tā gnyis pa ni/ pa tsi zhes pa ḍupa tsa/ ba tsi zhes pa/ ba tsa brjod/ si tsi zhes pa/ ṣi tsa 'jagari tsir rnam par mthor/ bi tsir tha dad pa'i dngos po/ mu tsi zhes pa/ mu grol ba rnams las pha rol tu ni tsa las iṭa med do/ /pak+tā/ wak+tā/ sek+tā/ rek+ta/ bek+tā/ mak+t+wo/ prats+tshi zhes pa/ prats+tsha shes par 'dod pa las tsha las iṭa med do/ /praṣ+ta/ yu dzir sbyor/ ru dzi zhes pa/ ru dzo 'joms/ rañji/ bhu dzi zhes pa/ rañja chos/ bhu dza skyong*/ bha dzi/ bhañji/ sañji zhes pa/ bha dza brten/ bhañjo nyed/ ṣañja chags/ t+yadzi/ bh+ras+dzi/ yis+dzizhes pa/ t+ya dza spong*/ bh+ras+dza 'tshed/ ya dza lha mchod/ mas+dzi/ sṛ dzi/ ni dzi zhes pa| ṭu mas+dzo dgasṛ dza spro/ ṇi dzir gtsang*/ bi dzi/ swan+dzi zhes pa/ bi dzir tha dad| ṣ+wañja yongs su 'khyud pa rnams las pha rol tu ni dza las so zhes pas/

iṭa med do/ /yok+tā/ rok+tā/ raṅk+tā/ bhok+tā/ bhak+tā/ baṅk+tā/ sak+tā/ t+yak+tā/ bh+rak+tā/ yaṣ+ta/ maṅk+tā/ 'di la mas+dzi na sha dag gi zhes pas/ na yig ā ga ma'o/ /praṣ+ta 'di la sṛ dṛ sha dag gi zhes pas a yig ā ga ma'o/ /nek+tā/ mek+ta/ swak+tā/ gsum pa na| a di/ ru di/ nu di zhes pa/ a da za/ ru da gzir/ ṇu de dad/ k+ṣu di swi d+ya ti| bi d+ya ti/ bin+da ti zhes pa k+ṣu dir rnam par mngagaṣ+wa da dbus kyi 'gyur byed| bi da yod/ bi thob/ 'di la mu tsa sogs las ā ga ma/ ba nat+ti zhes pa/ bi rnam par gcod pa la/ ru ngha sogs las na sgra/ ts+tshi dir gnyis su byed| bhi dir rnam par 'joms/ ha di sha di sa di zhes pa/ ha da bshang ba 'dor/ sha dman par byed/ ṣa rnam par 'gro/ pa di/ skan+di/ kha di zhes pa| pa da 'gro/ skan+dir skem/ khi da zhan pa la'o zhes pa 'di rnams las pha rol tu da las iṭa med de/ artā/ tot+tā sogs nas/ khet+tā zhes pa'i bar ro/ /ra nghi ru nghi k+ṣu nghi zhes pa/ ra ngha yang dag par 'grub/ ru nghir sgrib/ kru ngha khro/ k+ṣu ngha bkres/ bin+dha shu nghi zhes pa/ ban+dha 'ching*/ shu ngha gtsang*/ si ngh+ya ti/ bu ngh+ye/ ti zhes pa| ṣi nghu yang dag par mnyes/ bu ngha khong du chud/ yu nghi bya nghi swa ngh+ya ti zhes pa/ yu ngha kun nas 'khrug bya ngh+ya 'tshogapā ngha yang dag par 'grub ces pa'i rnams las pha rol tu ngha las iṭa med do/ /rāng+nghā/ rong+nghā/ krong+nghā sogs nas/ sāng+ngha zhes pa'i bar ro/ /ha ni ma n+ya ti zhes pa ha na 'tshe/ ma na shes pa 'di dag las pha rol tu na las iṭa med do/ /han+tā/ man+tā/ ma n+ya ti/ zhes yan gyi nges par bstan pa las so zhes sogs tan sogs can ldaugapa'i don du'o/ /de la iṭa yod pas/ ma ni tā/ bzhi pa ni/ ā pita/ pi ti s-i zhes pa/ āpl̥ khyab/ ta pa kun du gdung*/ ti sṛ 'gyur ba'i don/ swa pi/ wa pi/ sha pi zhes pa/ nyi ṣ+wapa nyal/ ḍuwapa sa bon 'debs/ sha pa smos/ tshu pi k+ṣi pi/ li pi/ zhes pa/ tshu pa reg/

k+ṣi pa ded/ lipa nye bar phyugalu pi/ sṛ pi/ zhes pa/ lupl̥ gcod/ pṛ pl̥ 'gro 'di rnams las pha rol tu pa las iṭa med do/ /yan+dhā/ ran+dhā/ lan+dhā/ ya mi| ra mi/ na mi/ ga mi zhes pa/ ya mu 'jigar mu rtse/ ṇa ma 'dud/ gaml̥ 'gro| 'di rnams las pha rol tu ma las iṭa med do/ /āp+tā/ tap+tā/ tep+tā/ swap+tā/ sogs nas sar+b+tā zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bshad pa las a yig ā ga ma byas nas| srap+tā zhes pa 'byung ngo*/ /ya bhi ra bhi la bhi zhes pa/ ya bha 'khrig ra bha rtsom/ ḍul bhaṣa thob/ ces pa 'di rnams las pha rol tu bha las iṭa med do| |yan+tā/ ran+tā/ nan+tā/ gan+tā/ lnga pa ni/ ri shi ru/ shi kru shi zhes pa/ ri sha dang ru sha 'tshe/ kru sha bod/ li shi bi shi di shi zhes pa/ li sha chung ba'i dngos pa/ོ/ bi sha 'jug di sha spyir btang*/ dṛ shi spri shi smṛ shi zhes pa/ dṛ shir lta/ spṛ sha regamṛ sha 'jugadi shi zhes pa/ di sha za 'di rnams las pha rol tu sha las iṭa med do/ reṣ+ta/ roṣ+ta/ kraṣ+to sogs te ṛ yig can rnams la a yig ā ga ma byas nas draṣ+ta sogs su 'gyur ro/ /twi ṣi pu ṣ+ya ti kṛ ṣi zhes pa/ twiṣa 'bar/ puṣa rgyas/ kṛṣa 'bri/ kl̥ ṣ+ya ti/ dwi ṣi/ pi ṣi zhes pa/ shl̥ṣa 'khrud/ dwiṣa mi dga'/ pi ṣl̥ phye mar byed/ bi ṣi shi ṣi shu ṣi zhes pa/ bi shl̥ khyab/ sha ṣ+li 'jigashu ṣa skem/ tu ṣi du ṣi zhes pa/ tuṣa dga'/ duṣa rnam par 'gyur zhes pa 'di rnams las pha rol tu ṣa las iṭa med do/ tweṣ+ta/ paṣ+to nas/ doṣ+tā 'di la'ang*/ pu ṣ+ya ti ni/ bhu sogs can dang*/ krī sogs can dgasnga ma rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /ba sa ti dang gha si zhes pa/ ba sa gnas/ gha si mdo las byung ba'i byings 'di dag las pha rol tu sa las iṭa med do/ bstā/ ghastā/ dzi ghat+sa ti/ ba sa ti zhes pa/ ba sa kun nas 'gebs pa ad sogs can 'gog pa'o/ /da hi di hi su hi zhes pa/ da ha thal bar byed/ di hi nye bar sog/du ha rab tu 'jo/

mi hi mu hi ru hi zhes pa/ mi ho gtor/ mu ga rnam par rmongs/ ru ha rab tu skye/ li hi lu hi na ni ba hi zhes pa/ li ha ro myang*/ lu ha 'jig ṇa ha 'ching*/ ba ha thob/ 'di rnams las pha rol tu ha las iṭa med do/ dag+nghā/ deg+nghā/ dog+nghā rnams dang po'i ha'i gha/ gzhan rnams la ha'i ḍha me wā sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gh+raha nye bar len/ guha zhes pa/ gu hū kun las sgrib/ 'di dag las san la iṭa med ces pa'o/ /dzi gh+ri k+ṣa ti/ dzu ghuk+ṣa ti/ gra hi las sam pra sā ra ṇa byas pa'o/ /yu spel ba sogs byings u yig mtha' las kyang san la iṭa med do/ yu yū ṣa ti/ ru ru ṣa ti sogs/ dbyangs mtha' rnams kyi san la ring po byas pa'o/ /di bu rtse ba sogs/ i ba mtha' dang*/ ṛ ngha bh+ras+dza dan+bhu zhes pa ṛ nghu 'phel| bh+ras+dza 'tshed/ dan+bhu tshul 'chos/ shrinya bsten/ yu spel/ ur+ṇunya 'gebs/ bhar zhes pa/ bhṛnya 'dzin/ dz+nya khong du chud pa la in mthar sa yig ā ga ma byas pas/ dz+nyā pis ni ta ni zhes pa ni/ ṣa ṇu sbyin/ ta nu rgyas/ pa 'gro/ da ri drā 'gro ba ngan pa rnams kyi pha rol tu san la iṭa yang na 'gyur ba'o/ /di de bi ṣa ti/ yang na/ du dhū ṣā ti/ tsha wa dag gi lnga pa la'ang sha ūṭa'o/ /zhes pas wa yig gi uṭa'o/ /san gyi cho ga gzhan ni kun 'dra'o/ /ar+hi nghi ṣa ti/ yang na/ ā ti'i i'o/ /zhes par dz+nyā pa dang*/ ṛ nghi'i byings ni san la pha rol la grangs ji ltar ba bzhin/ zhes pas/ ī dang*/ īr du byas pas/ īr ngh+wa ti/ bi bh+ras+dzi ṣa ti/ yang na brtsegs pa dang po'i sa ka phyis pas/ bi bh+rak+ṣa ti/ di dam+bhi ṣa ti/ yang na/ dan+bhī'i i ta'ang ngo zhes pas/ nghip+sa ti/ shi shra yi ṣa ti/ shi shi ṣa ti| yi ya bi ṣa ti/ yu yū ṣa ti/ pror+ṇu na bi ṣa ti/ pror+ṇu nū ṣa ti dang po las gnyis pa'i 'os nu sgra/ bi bha ri ṣa ti/ bu bhar+ṣa ti/ dzi dz+nyī pa ya ṣa ti/ dz+nyīp+sa ti/ si sa ni ṣa ti/ si saṃ sa/ ti/

ti ta ni/ ṣa ti/ ti taṃ pa ti/ pa pa ti ṣa ti/ pit+sa ti/ di da ri drās ti/ bhu yod pa las pha rol dbyings thams cad pa ma yin pa las si tsa 'jig par 'gyur ba la iṭa med do/ /a bhuta/ sṛ 'gro bṛng dag ḍu bhṛnya 'dzin| ṣa las ldog pa/ ṇu bstod/ dru 'gro/ shru thos/ sru khro/ 'di rnams nyid las/ pa ro3k+ṣā la iṭa ā ga ma mi 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i ba ma/ sa sṛ ma/ sogs dang*/ ruṣ+tu ba sogs so/ /hṛnya 'phrog pa sogs kyi byings/ ṛ yig mtha' can las pa ro3k+ṣā'i thal la iṭa mi 'gyur ba'o/ /dza har+tha/ ḍukṛnya las de ma thag tu 'chad pa'i suṭa ā ga ma med pa'i pa ro3k+ṣā las iṭa mi 'gyur ro// tsakṛ ba tsa kar+tha/ gnyis pa ni/ kṛnya las zhes pa zhugs te/ sam dang pa ri dang u pa rnams sngon gyi kṛnya las rgyan dang 'dus pa'i don la suṭa ā ga ma 'gyur zhing*| de yang nyer bsgyur de rnams las pha rol byings kyi sngon du sbyin no/ saṃskartā/ pa ri/ skartā/ u pa skartā/ saṃskastuṃ/ saṃskartā byaṃ/ nyer bsgyur gsum po las gzhan pa'i pra sogs las mi 'gyur ro/ /suṭa'i ud dang ṭa ni rjes 'brel lo/ /kun bshad par rkang pa bdun pa'i 'grel pa rdzogs so// //brgyad pa la/ lus 'gyur gyi rkang pa la/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung brda chad bshad pa'o/ /dang po la tshig mtha'i dang*/ pha rol gyi rkyen gyi dang*/ tshu rol byings kyi lus 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni/ rnam dbye byin nas tshig tu grub zin pa rnams mthar byung ba'i nghuṭa rnams kyi gzugs ni rang rang gi dang por bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dzā gṛ gnyid sad| tsa kā sṛ 'bar/ phyi ma'i ṛ rjes 'brel/ di/ si sgrub tshul snga ma bzhin byas pas/ snga ma'i tshig mtha'i ra dang phyi ma'i tshig mtha'i sa yig dag gi rnam par bcad pa zhig tu btang bas/ a dzā gaḥ a tsa kāḥ rnam dbye'i cha shas/ pa tsa bas/ mas/ an bi/ a'i ba ma dag la ring po/ pa tsā baḥ pa tsā maḥ gnyis pa ni/ byings mtha'i gha dang ḍha dang ngha dang bha rnams las pha rol dang*|

de yang nghā ring po min pa'i pha rol las rkyen ta dang tha dag gi gzugs ni ngha ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /'di ni 'go nas sgra med pa rnams la/ zhes sogs dang por thob pa de 'gog pa'i phyir du bkod pa'o/ /duha 'jo/ tas/ an bi 'jigad dang po'i ha'i gha/ nghuṭa rnams kyi sogs byas pas/ dug+dhaḥ thas la'ang dug+nghaḥ nyid do/ /li ha ro myang*/ thas ha'i ḍha/ ṣa dang ṭa sde las ta sde'i ṭa sde'o zhes pas| tha ngha ru bsgyur ba rnams kyang ḍha/ ḍha'i ḍha las dbyi zhing dbyangs u pa nghā ring pa'o/ /zhes pa 'dis/ ḍha snga ma dbyi zhing*/ ī ring po byas pas l̥̄ ḍhaḥ bungha rtogs/ a d+ya ra nī'i thās/ si tsa/ nghuṭa las kyang sogs/ a bung+nghāḥ ḍu la bha ṣa thob/ sgrub tshul snga ma bzhin byas pas/ a lan+dhāḥ gsum pa la/ rkyen spyi 'gro la brten pa dang*/ bye brag la brten pa dang*/ slar yang spyi la brten pa'i byings kyi lus 'gyur ro/ /dang po la gsal byed kyi dang*| dbyangs kyi lus 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni/ byings mtha'i ṣa yig dang ḍha yig dag gi gzugs ni sa yig pha rol la ka yig tu bsgyur bya'o/ /pi ṣl̥ phye mar byed/ li ha ro myang*/ s+ya ti/ s+yata/ pek+ṣ+yati/ a pe k+ṣ+ya ti/ lek+ṣ+yati/ byings de gnyis la/ tum| san/ tum 'jigasan gyi bya ba byas pas/ pa pik+ṣa ti/ li lik+ṣa ti/ zhar byung*/ byings mtha'i ṣa yig dang ṭa sde las pha rol gyi ta sde'i gzugs ni/ ṭa sde nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /pi ṣ+li/ īṭa bstod snga ma la tā/ yon tan phyi ma la ste/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigapeṣ+tā/ īṭ+ṭe/ ḍha yig pha rol la ḍha snga ma'i gzugs ni dbyi bar bya ste/ rang gi u pa nghā ring por yang bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dper brjod brjod zin pa bzhin dang*/ gzhan yang*/ li ha ro myang*/ gu hū kun nas sgrib/ niṣ+ṭha'o zhes pas k+ta dang k+ta ban+tu/ ha'i gha sogs sngar bzhin byas pas/ līḍhā/ lī ḍha bān/ snga ma la s-i rnam bcad/ phyi ma la gsal byed las kyang ngo dang*/

an+tu las mtha'i yang byings min pa'i si la 'os ring po'o/ /sa hi ba ha zhes pa/ ṣaha bzod/ ba ha thob/ tā/ ha'i ḍha sogs byas pa'i ḍha phyis shing*| byings kyi a yig dag ni ata to/ /so nghā/ bo nghā/ tshul rol gyi nghuṭa rnams kyi gzugs ni/ pha rol gyi sde pa'i bzhi pa rnams la tshu rol rnams gsum pa rnams su 'gyur ro/ /a dug+ngha/ a bungha/ 'dis sa yig da ru 'gyur ba sogs/ 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pa'i nghuṭa thams cad/ rang rang gi sde pa'i gsum par bsgyur bar bya'o/ /tsa kā sri/ pañca mī'i hi/ an bi 'jigahu nghuṭa dag las hi'i nghi/ tsakānghi sgra med pa rnams pha rol tu byung ba la tshu rol gyi shi ṭa ma yin pa'i gsal byed rnams kyi gzugs ni/ rang rang gi sde pa'i dang por bsgyur bar bya'o/ /bid shes/ tā/ bet+tā/ bhṛ dza'i ming can/ bh+ras+dza 'tshed pa'i byings kyi dbyangs las pha rol gyi gsal byed s+dza yig ni/ rkyen dbyangs pha rol la gnyis su 'gyur ro/ ti an bi/ gra hi zhes pas sam pra sā ra ṇa/ 'dis s+dza gnyis/ nghuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas sa'i da/ ta sde'i tsa ṭa'i sogs kyis da'i dza/ bradz+dza dz+dzati/ tsan+d+ra par/ hal las dz+dzar la dzhar rnams kyi mthun pa'i gnas su dbyi ba yang yin no zhes pas/ bar gyi dza gnyis dbyi bar bya ba yin pas/ bhṛdz+dza ti/ gnyis pa ni/ byings mthar byung ba'i a'i yi ge rnam dbye'i ba dang ma dag la ring por bsgyur bar bya'o/ /pa tsā baḥ pa tsā ba(ma)ཿ gaml̥ 'gro/ mi/ an bi/ gaṃ i ṣu sogs kyi cha/ dbyangs las pha rol sogs/ gats+tshā mi/ byings dbyangs mtha' can rnams kyi dbyangs ni san pha rol la ring por bsgyur bar bya'o/ /tsi tsī ṣa ti/ dzu hū ṣa ti/ han 'tshe ba dang*/ ing gi lus 'gyur/ gam dag gi san la u pa nghā'i dbyangs ring por bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dzi ghaṃ pa ti/ dzi gāṃ pa ti/ byings kyi nā min gyi dbyangs ni ra dang ba dag pha rol la ring por 'gyur te/ de yang ra ba gsal byed pha rol can la ste/

'on kyang ḍukṛnya byings thams cad pa min pa la brten pa'i lus 'gyur/ kur dang*/ tshur gcod pa'i byings dag gi dbyangs ni ring por 'gyur ba ma yin pa'i 'o/ /shṝ 'tshe/ sṝ skyong te yan ṝta mtha'i sogs dang*/ mchur gyur sogs/ shrīr+ya te/ sur+yā te/ di bu rtse/ ṣi bu thags 'thagashri bu 'gro/ ti/ yaṇa/ dī bya ti/ sī bya ti/ shrī bya ti/ kur tshur la/ kur+yāta/ tshur+yāta/ zhar byung*/ h+ya ta na'i di pha rol la sa'i yi ge ni ta ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /shā su rjes su ston/ di/ an bi/ 'jiga'adis sa'i ta/ gsal byed las di dbyi/ ashāta/ gnyis pa la/ h+yasta nī'i sogs gsum dang*/ ā shī ṣa sogs gsum la brten pa'i lus 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni/ byings kyi dang por rnam dbye h+yasta nī'i dang*/ a d+ya ta nī'i dang*/ bya ba shor ba rnams pha rol la aṭa ā ga ma ga zhag par bya'o/ /ya dza lha mchod/ di gnyis/ an bi/ a d+ya ta nī la si tsa las so zhes pas/ īṭa/ a'i yang ring po'o/ /a ya dzata/ ak+ṣīta/ phyi ma la bhṛ dza sogs rnams kyi ṣa/ ṣa ḍha dag gi sogs byas pa'o/ /kṛ/ bya ba shor ba'i s+yata/ han dang ṛta mtha' las s+ya la 'os iṭa/ yon tan/ a ka ri ṣ+yata rkyen gsum po de pha rol la byings dbyangs dang po can rnams kyi dang po'i 'phel bar bsgyur bar bya'o/ /īk+ṣa lta ba/ u ha rnam rtog/byed pa po la rutsa sogs byas pas/ h+yasta nī'i āt+ma ne'i ta/ an bi/ aik+ṣa ta/ au ha ta a d+ya ta| nī'i yang ta dang*/ bya ba shor ba'i s+yata sbyar/ snga ma la si tsa dang*/ gnyis ka la iṭa byas pas/ au k+ṣiṣ+ta/ au hiṣ+ta/ ai k+ṣi ṣ+ya ta/ au hi ṣ+yata/ rkyen de gsum la byings a yig dang po can gyi a yig gi ā yig go /aṭa 'gro/ ā ḍata ā ḍi ṣ+yata/ s+yegah+yasta nī'i pha rol la asti'i ming can/ as yod pa'i ā yig ā yig go /tām/ an/ an bi 'jiga.āstī/ ā san/ a d+ya ta nī dang*/ bya ba shor ba 'di la mi sbyor te/ de gnyis la byings de bhu ru bsgyur bar gong du bshad pas so/
/e ti'i ming can iṇa 'gro ba'i byings/ h+yasta nī'i la ya ru bsgyur ba'i ya yig pha rol la a yig ā ga ma'o/

/rkyen de'i an/ an bi 'jiga.iṇa'i 'ang ngo zhes pas ya ā yan/ ā ga ma de dag kyang mā'i sgra dang*/ māsma'i sgra sbyor ba la thob pa ma yin no/ /ḍupa tsa/ mā bha bān dang*/ ārma sngon/ a d+ya ta nī'i di/ si tsa/ a'i yang ring po/ iṭa/ tsa sde'i 'dra ba'i sogs/ mā bhā wān/ pak+ṣīta/ mā sma pāk+ṣīta/ ū ha rnam par rtogamā da māsma sngon/ di/ 'dis 'phel ba bkag si tsa/ iṭa/ ha'i ḍha sogs/ mok+ṣīta/ māsmo k+ṣīta/ 'di'i ma zhes pa 'ad| asmad kyi lus 'gyur/ twā mā ni gnyis pa la'o zhes pa'i mā yin nam zhe na min te/ māsma'i sgra dang lhan gcig spyod pa'i tshig phrad yin no/ /twā mī'i mā yin na| aṭa ma bkag te/ pa dā mā bha wan a pa sh+yata/ ces aṭa bshad pas sa/ོ/ gnyis pa ni/ nā min mtha' can gyi byings las pha rol tu byung ba'i ā shī ṣa dang*/ a d+ya ta ni dang*/ pa ro3k+ṣā rnams kyi ngha'i gzugs ni ḍha ru bsgyur bar bya'/ོ/ tsinya sogs/ rkyen gnyis po'i sī ngh+wam dang*/ ngham dang*/ ngh+we/ dang po la yon tan dang*| bar pa gnyis la aṭa/ tse ṣī a tse / tha ma gnyis brjod sogs sṛ bṛ bhṛ sū| sru sogs kyis iṭa/ snga ma brtsegs pa min pa'i zhes pas ya/ tsi ts+yi*| gsum pa ni/ rkyen pha rol la mārdza zhes pa/ mṛdzuṣa dag pa'i byings ni mārdzi zhes par 'gyur bar bya'o/ /shwasta nī'i tā/ bhṛdza sogs kyi ṣa/ ṣa dang ṭa sde sogs mā / rkyen pha rol la byings kyi dang po na yod pa'i ṣa'i sa ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ṇi na ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ ṣa ha bzod/ ṇu bstod/ te/ an bi/ sa ha te/ na ba te/ rgyu mtshan zhes pa nā mi dang ka dang ra las pha rol tu byung ba'i rkyen dang rnam 'gyur dang ā ga ma la gnas pa sa'i yi ge ni ṣa nyid do zhes pas der bsgyur/ rkyen la gnas pa ni/ tsinya sogs/ ti/ san/ an bi/ tsi tsī ṣa ti/ rnam 'gyur la gnas pa ni/ ṣitsa 'dzag pa ro3k+ṣā'i aṭa/ byings kyi dang po ṣa'i sa sogs/ gnyis brjod sogs si ṣe tsa/

ā ga ma la gnas pa ni/ kṛ pa ri sngon tā/ saṃ pa ri las suṭa/ yon tan/ pa riṣ+kārtā/ shā si ba si zhes/ shā su rjes su ston/ ba sa nges par gnas/ gha si zhes pa/ a da'i lus 'gyur/ ghasli rnams kyi sa yang ṣa nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /snga ma la gnyis la/ te/ yaṇa/ shā si'i u pa nghā'i aṇa dang gsal byed dag la ita/ phyi ma la swa pi wa tsi sogs kyis saṃ pra shi ṣ+ya te/ u ṣ+ya re/ gsum pa las pa ro3k+ṣā'i a tus/ gnyis brjod/ gaṃ han sogs kyis u pa nghā phyis/ sgra med sogs/ dzak+ṣa tuḥ ṣ+tunya bstod pa la 'phel ba byas pa'i stau ti ste/ ṣ+tunya nyi dang*/ byings in kā ri ta'i mtha' can nyid dag gi sa yig ni/ ṣaha zhes pa san pha rol la ṣa nyid du bsgyur bar bya'/ོ/ ṣ+tu nya/ tum/ san/ gnyis brjod sogs shiṭa las pha rol gyi sgra med pa'o// zhes pas sa phyis nas tu lhag mar byas/ a bh+yasta'i sa yig 'dis ṣa ru bsgyur bas/ tuṣ+tu ṣa ti/ ṣitsa 'dzag in/ tum/ san/ ti/ iṭa/ si ṣetsa yi ṣa ti/ 'jig go zhes pa'i sgra yis brjod pa'i dbyi ba byas pa de la rkyen gyi bya ba ltar byas pa de gnas pa ma yin te/ rkyen zhig na des byas pa'i bya ba yang 'jig ces pa'o/ /aṅga/ bu brgyud la aṇa 'phel/ mang tshig dzas/ grags pa rnams kyi mang po nyid la zhes pas bu brgyud 'jig/'dis dang po'i 'phel ba yang zhig pas/ aṅgaḥ tsa ṇa pa ro3k+ṣā zhes sogs/ gnyis brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan can gyi dbyangs las gnyis brjod pa byas na phyis dbyangs kyi cho ga bya'o/ /pā btung*| a tus/ gnyis brjod sogs/ 'dis dbyangs kyi cho gabyings thams cad pa ma yin pa'i la ī dbyi'o sogs bya'o/ /pa pa tuḥ de bzhin du/ rkyen de dang*/ gaml̥ 'gro ba sbyar/ gnyis brjod/ dbyangs kyi cho ga gam han zhes sogs kyis u pa nghā phyis pas/ dzag+ma tuḥ byings rkyen la sogs pa thams cad kyi yi ge gang rjes su 'brel ba de nyid ni/ mi sbyor te/ 'phyid dgos pa'i phyir ro/
